rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Floribunda.
Registration name: DICinfra
Exhibition name: Disco Dancer
rows.Origin: Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom). Bred by Patrick Dickson (1926-2012) (United Kingdom, 1984).
rows.Bloom: Orange or orange-red. Mild fragrance. 10 petals. Average diameter 2.5". Semi-double (9-16 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
